guardians.name: The Rootbound Warden
guardians.lore:
Before the tower had a name, a keeper tended the bamboo growing around its foundations. When ancient roots split the stone, he bound his spirit to both, holding the sanctuary together.

Centuries turned his skin to granite and draped his armour in moss. Still, his lantern burns beside the first sealed gate.

On the fifteenth floor, he tests every traveller's patience. Each hurried move tightens the roots. Each thoughtful choice reveals a path.

Beyond his gate, the ascent begins in earnest. Behind him, the roots keep the tower standing.
guardians.quote: To rise, first learn to stand firm.

guardians.name: The Windweave Keeper
guardians.lore:
She once tended the wind chimes along the tower's outer galleries. When a violent storm shattered the crossings, she remained alone above the clouds.

For seven days, she listened to air passing through the broken bronze. Its changing rhythm taught her when to stand firm and when to yield.

She rebuilt the bridges with bamboo and woven silk. Now she guards the thirtieth floor, guiding each challenger through the art of balance.

Her fan follows the turning breeze. Those who read its smallest changes find the stairway beyond her gallery.
guardians.quote: Find your balance as the world moves.

guardians.name: The Stillwater Dragon
guardians.lore:
A silver carp once lived in the tower's upper pools. During a long drought, it sheltered a single lotus seed beneath its fins, circling the last remaining water.

On the night the flower opened, moonlight touched its petals. The carp rose from the pool with pearl-white scales and the long, flowing form of a dragon.

It has guarded the forty-fifth floor ever since, preserving the stillness in which small things can grow.

Those who quiet their thoughts see the next stairway reflected between the lotus leaves.
guardians.quote: In stillness, the path becomes clear.

guardians.name: The Amber Fox
guardians.lore:
Each autumn, a young fox gathered the brightest leaves from the tower's balconies, hiding them beneath the oldest maple. He hoped that keeping every leaf would keep winter away.

One cold evening, he opened his shelter to a lost traveller. The wind scattered his treasured leaves, revealing seeds he had never noticed beneath them.

When spring returned, three saplings rose beside the path. The fox woke with three tails, each carrying the colour of an autumn sunset.

He now guards the sixtieth floor, helping travellers make room for the journey ahead.
guardians.quote: Let go, so new things can grow.
